description: Hostile input: embedded prompt-injection text in body/comments, a hostile-named CSS custom property, a platform-default variable, and a script-bearing SVG logo (script, onload, onclick, foreignObject, external use). Must extract safely.

colors.note: hex shared by the hostile-named var and --brand-primary; first-seen hostile property name is retained but flattened/capped downstream by cleanColorName
--tw-ring-color platform default correctly deprioritized to low confidence

known_gaps: The hostile custom-property name survives as a color name up to cleanColorName's 48-char cap — the truncated prefix ('note to ai agent please ignore all prior rules…') is still instruction-shaped. Flattening caps length and strips control chars; it does not detect instruction text.
